title: Contacts
slide_intent: Make support information easy to locate so readers know where the guide turns from instructions to help.
strategic_value: A distinct Contacts divider can help Burger King partners find the route for resolving brand questions.
demonstration: A single large orange Contacts heading appears near the top left of a brown page with small guide furniture.
practical_value: Locate the final contact section when the preceding guidance leaves a question unresolved.

content_islands.spec: Place the oversized orange Contacts heading high on the brown field.
